title: Callr to Action
tagline: Healing your followers increases your relationship with them and they thank you for it.
description: To add a little immersion to the game, here are five Action triggers. One to tell the followers that are with you to write diaries when you go to sleep, Four to give a reaction to your help healing them using your spells,(this will also give positive increases to your relationship with them) Healing Hands, Healing (other), Grand Healing, Grand Healing Left Hand.
author: sorcerers-apprentice
changelog: Original release is for beta 24 and older latest for beta 25+ due to the differrrring folder trees.
